collections.name: INDIGO
collections.dye_note: Indigo leaves ferment into a dark vat. Cloth comes out yellow-green and turns blue as it meets the air.
collections.summary: Meet the feelings you hide and the patterns you keep repeating, one question a night.
description: INDIGO is the first Khram journal.
Three Acts move from noticing, to understanding, to growing: The Deep Night, The Still Water and The First Light. Every prompt page is followed by a full page to write on.
collections.art: A full moon over a still lake, with one pale-blue butterfly.

swatch.alt: Deep indigo texture, darker in places.

th.theme: สำรวจด้านมืดในใจ (Shadow work)

th.summary: ทำความรู้จักความรู้สึกที่ซ่อนไว้ และรูปแบบเดิมๆ ที่เราทำซ้ำ คืนละหนึ่งคำถาม
description: INDIGO คือสมุดเล่มแรกของ Khram
สามองก์พาจากการสังเกต ไปสู่การเข้าใจ แล้วค่อยๆ เติบโต: The Deep Night, The Still Water และ The First Light ทุกหน้าคำถามมีหน้าว่างให้เขียนตามมาอีกหนึ่งหน้า

collections.name: CRIMSON
collections.dye_note: Lac is a resin left on tree branches by a tiny insect. Boiled, it gives a deep red dye.
collections.summary: For anxious attachment: the pull to check, the fear of being left, and learning to steady yourself.
description: CRIMSON is a workbook for anxious attachment. It explains what is happening when you can't stop checking your phone, then gives you tools and prompts for when it happens.
It is being written and designed now. Contents may change before release.
collections.art: One crimson thread across the night sky, a red-winged moth, and a moon half in shadow.

swatch.alt: Deep crimson texture, uneven in places.

th.art: ด้ายสีแดงเส้นเดียวพาดผ่านท้องฟ้ากลางคืน ผีเสื้อกลางคืนปีกแดง และพระจันทร์ที่อยู่ในเงาครึ่งดวง
th.theme: ความรักและความผูกพัน

th.summary: สำหรับคนที่ผูกพันแบบกังวล: อยากเช็คตลอด กลัวถูกทิ้ง และกำลังหัดทำใจให้นิ่ง
description: CRIMSON คือเวิร์กบุ๊กสำหรับความผูกพันแบบกังวล อธิบายว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นตอนที่เราหยุดเช็คโทรศัพท์ไม่ได้ แล้วให้เครื่องมือกับคำถามไว้ใช้ตอนที่มันเกิดขึ้น
ตอนนี้กำลังเขียนและออกแบบอยู่ เนื้อหาอาจเปลี่ยนก่อนวางขาย

collections.name: SAFFRON
collections.dye_note: Chips of jackfruit heartwood, simmered in water, dye the warm yellow of Thai forest monks' robes.
collections.summary: Breathing, noticing and resting pages for nights when your thoughts won't slow down.
description: SAFFRON is planned as a quieter, body-first journal: slow breathing, noticing what your body is doing, and rest without guilt.
No release date yet.
collections.art: The first light of dawn and slow ripples on still water.

th.art: แสงแรกของรุ่งเช้า กับระลอกน้ำช้าๆ บนผิวน้ำนิ่ง

collections.name: EBONY
collections.dye_note: Cloth soaked in crushed ebony fruit is dried in the sun again and again. It darkens to black a little more each time.
collections.summary: A gentle place to remember, and to write what you didn't get to say.
description: EBONY is planned as a journal for grief: room to remember, to write to someone or something you have lost, and to carry it at your own pace.
No release date yet.
collections.art: A new moon, white night flowers, and an empty chair by the water.

swatch.alt: Near-black ebony texture with faint brown tones.

th.theme: ความสูญเสียและความเศร้า

products.summary: 121 pages, 150+ prompts and a 30-night moon tracker, made for writing on an iPad or any tablet.
description: It's 2 a.m. and your mind is replaying a conversation from three days ago. You said “I'm fine” again today. You keep saying yes when you mean no, then wonder why you feel so tired.

INDIGO is for people who feel deeply, think too much, and are done being told to “just stay positive.” No forced gratitude. No pretending. Just honest questions, quiet space, and room to understand the parts of yourself you learned to hide.
included: 121 pages designed as one continuous journey
150+ guided shadow work prompts across 50+ themed sessions
A full lined writing page after every prompt page
30-day Indigo Moon Tracker: color one moon each night
A Letter to Your Younger Self and A Letter to Your Future Self
Affirmations you write in your own words
“Before You Move Forward” check-ins at the end of each Act
A closing reflection and a written promise to yourself
Moonlit, impasto-style artwork on every page

how_it_works: Download the PDF right after purchase.
Import it into GoodNotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Xodo, Samsung Notes or any PDF annotation app.
Write in a light ink. White, gold or lavender shows up best on the indigo pages.
Go at your own pace. One prompt a day or one a week; there's no wrong speed.

items.text: Recognize. The emotions you hide, the fears you carry and the patterns you keep repeating. Prompts for overthinking, triggers, people-pleasing and your inner critic.
items.title: Act I · The Deep Night

items.text: Understand. Gentle inner child work: the rules you learned growing up, the needs that went unmet, the boundaries you never got to set. Skip any memory that feels too heavy.
items.title: Act II · The Still Water

items.text: Grow. Self-worth, a kinder inner voice, rest without guilt, and small promises you can actually keep.
items.title: Act III · The First Light

outline.heading: Three Acts, one night at a time

sample_prompts: What have I been trying not to feel?
When do I say yes while wanting to say no?
What does this fear reveal about something I deeply value?
What did I learn about expressing sadness, anger, or fear?
What would progress look like if I measured it with patience rather than perfection?

faq.a: No. This edition is a digital PDF and nothing is shipped. For a printed copy, see the INDIGO paperback.

No. INDIGO is a page-by-page journey, meant to be worked through in order.

products.summary: A clean white writing panel on every page, framed in black with moon and star details. Made to write in with any pen or pencil.
description: It's 2 a.m. and your mind is replaying a conversation from three days ago. You said “I'm fine” again today. You keep saying yes when you mean no, then wonder why you feel so tired.

INDIGO is for people who feel deeply, think too much, and are done being told to “just stay positive.” No forced gratitude. No pretending. Just honest questions, quiet space, and room to understand the parts of yourself you learned to hide.
The Black & White Edition is the practical one: a white panel to write on, any pen you like. Prefer the moonlit art in color? Choose the Full Color Edition.
included: 150+ guided prompts across 50+ themed sessions
A full page to write on after every prompt page
A 30-night moon tracker with a simple mood key
A letter to your younger self and a letter to your future self
“Before You Move Forward” check-ins at the end of each Act
A closing reflection and a written promise to yourself

items.text: Recognize. The emotions you hide, the fears you carry and the patterns you keep repeating. Prompts for overthinking, triggers, people-pleasing and your inner critic.
items.title: Act I · The Deep Night

items.text: Understand. Gentle inner child work: the rules you learned growing up, the needs that went unmet, the boundaries you never got to set. Skip any memory that feels too heavy.
items.title: Act II · The Still Water

items.text: Grow. Self-worth, a kinder inner voice, rest without guilt, and small promises you can actually keep.
items.title: Act III · The First Light

outline.heading: Three Acts, one night at a time

products.summary: Seven nights, fourteen questions, no right answers. A small way to start.
description: A free shadow work mini-journal: a small, quiet way to start meeting the parts of you that usually stay in the dark. The overthinking, the people-pleasing, the feelings you've learned to hide.

Each night starts with one short grounding step (a slow breath, a hand on your chest, your feet on the floor), then two prompts and a full lined page to write on. Ten minutes is enough. Skip anything that feels too heavy tonight.
These prompts come from INDIGO. If the seven nights open something, the rest of the journey is there when you want it.
included: 18-page PDF, instant download
14 shadow work prompts and 7 grounding steps
Dark, art-led pages made for iPad (GoodNotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Xodo); opens in any PDF app
